# Programming Notebook

A collection of personal web and Python projects.

## Projects

- `COMMENTARIUM/` - literature discussion app
- `GROUND/` - GROUND demos, site, and meeting materials
- `ai_grocery_list/` - grocery-list app experiments
- `bias-auditor-web/` - AI bias-auditing tools
- `games/` - browser-based games
- `tools/contract-analyzer/` - contract analysis scripts
- `web-apps/` - standalone web apps

## Credentials and generated files

Python clients use the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable rather than
embedding credentials in source. Keep API keys, generated reports, local input
documents, and dependency folders out of commits; the repository ignore rules
cover the common local-only files in this collection.
